description: Grants the embedded WebDriver plugin's permission for the WDIO E2E suite (`e2e/`). Staged into src-tauri/capabilities/e2e.json only for the duration of an e2e-harness build by stageCapability.mjs, then removed — the plugin's permission manifest doesn't exist in a normal build (the dependency is optional), so a permanently-present capability file referencing it fails cargo's permission-resolution check.
